rows.en: Hell yeah!
Good!
We did it.
We did it...!
Allll right!
All right! We did it!!
We did it!
Well done!
Good!
All right, we did it!
Mission complete.
Target eliminated.
The details of the next match appeared on the monitor.

Opponent: Aquatic Kaijin Team
Venue: Floor 2 North, City Outskirts
City Outskirts...? Looks like it's on Floor 2.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
So our next opponents are the Aquatic Kaijin Team.
This is Floor 2. The next venue was the City Outskirts, right?
Beam ropes...? So it's someone else's match...
Hmph. Guess I'll stick around and watch a bit.
Valky... Do you, too, seek to make a name for yourself by striking down Zamsha?
What else would I be here for!!
Forgive me, but I have no time to waste on small fry.
What did you say!? ...Dyaah!!
Hmph!!
Don't you make me mad!! Come ooon, bring iiit!!
...Heh.
Nnnghhhh...!!
...Hmph!
You bastard...!!
Hah!! Haah!! Dyaaaaah!!
Gwah...!!
...I-I have failed...
Zamsha... What incredible skill!! He's not called the Space Swordsman for nothing...!
So that's the Space Swordsman everyone's talking about.
He's every bit as good as the rumors say.
He's every bit as good as the rumors say.
Those moves aren't just for show...!
That's incredible...!
...Zamsha, the Space Swordsman. I'll remember that.
...So that's Zamsha, the Space Swordsman. I'll remember him.
S-strong doesn't even begin to cover it...
...That's one guy I wouldn't want as an enemy.
H-he's pretty damn good!!
...That's one guy I wouldn't want as an enemy.
...Moves like that... He's no ordinary fighter!
Zamsha... So there was a guy like this out here...!!
Yeah. Also known as the Space Swordsman...
He's every bit as good as the rumors say.
He's every bit as good as the rumors say.
Those moves aren't just for show...!
That's incredible...!
...Zamsha. I'll remember that.
...So that's Zamsha. I'll remember him.
S-strong doesn't even begin to cover it...
...That's one guy I wouldn't want as an enemy.
H-he's pretty damn good!!
...That's one guy I wouldn't want as an enemy.
...Moves like that... He's no ordinary fighter!
Zamsha noticed {8074} and the team and came over to speak to them.
I seek battle with the strong.
If you are truly strong, we shall surely face each other in the finals.
I look forward to that day. Until we meet again.
The City Outskirts. So this is the match venue... You ready?
Tch, we don't have time to spare. Hurry it up.
Come out!! I'll be your opponent!!
Looks like they're here.
Abiiih!! Abi-abi! Abiiih!!
So it's you!? Shiomaneking!!
We meet again!
This place will be your graveyard!!
That's my line!!
All right... Looks like our opponent showed up right on cue.
Abiiih!! Abi-abi! Abiiih!!
We meet again!
This place will be your graveyard!!
All right! We beat him!! Shiomaneking... He was a tough opponent.
That's win number four, huh? We're really startin' to hit our stride!!
That's our fourth win! Things are going smoothly!
Four wins in a row. Well, not that it's any surprise.

notes.note: #0.27-0.38 are slots 2-13 of the victory block begun at #0.26 (story_072). 0422.bla order 14,15,12,11,5,4,3,2,1,6,7,9,10 = Mebius, Zero, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Den-O (Momotaros), RX, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00. Voices match (Zero 'yossha', OOO trailing, Momotaros 'yatta ze', Heero 'mission complete', Setsuna 'target eliminated'). #0.33 RX = same source as #0.26 Mebius, same English.
Rider 1's 'yatta na!' read as congratulating the team: 'Well done!'.
'Mission complete.' follows the latest tournament precedent (story_071 0414 #0.128); older slices used 'Mission... complete.'

Match card kept as a deliberate two-line layout. 'Dai-2-sou' = 'Floor 2' following story_071/072 ('Floor 1'). Suisei kaijin team = 'Aquatic Kaijin Team' (Shiomaneking's squad; not in glossary). 'Shigaichi kougai' = 'City Outskirts'. North spelled out as in 071.
Ankh labelled; 'This is Floor 2' restores the subject for the bare 'Dai-2-sou da'.
Ankh comes across another team's match (beam ropes = the ring boundary SE in the script).
'Shireta koto wo!!' (that goes without saying) rendered as a defiant rhetorical answer.
Alien Valky's drawn-out 'kakatte koooi' kept stretched.
'Munen' (defeat with regret) -> 'I have failed', matching the precedent in story_051 (0325 #0.114).
'Uchuu kengou' (Zamsha's epithet) = 'Space Swordsman' (Ultraman Wiki usage); not in glossary. Zamsha is male per glossary.

#0.18-0.29 and #0.34-0.45: 12 leader variants each. 0424.bla order 15,12,11,6,7,9,10,5,4,3,2,1 = Zero, Seven, Ultraman, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00, OOO, W, Den-O (Momotaros), RX, Rider 1 (Mebius excluded: he speaks #0.17 in this branch). Voices match: Nu 'date ja nai' (Amuro), Heero/Setsuna 'oboete okou', OOO stammer, Momotaros 'yaru ja nee ka'. Identical source -> identical English (#0.19/20, #0.26/28 etc.).
00's variant differs from Wing Zero's only by a questioning 'ka'; rendered 'So that's...' and 'him' to keep the two distinct.
Ankh's branch (plays when Mebius is not present, instead of #0.17). #0.34 is Zero answering him; the rest of the block repeats #0.19-0.29 without the epithet in #0.39/0.40.
Narration; {8074} = party leader name, padding dropped per brief. 'and the team' follows story_071 (0414 #0.89).
'Kessho de aimamieru' = face each other in the finals; archaic register kept for Zamsha.
Yes/No prompt; 0425.bla shows Ankh's name box (CHARA_NAME 36), though the slice has no label. Same phrasing as 0422 #0.1 in story_072.
Ankh's 'kita you da ze?' rendered as a statement; the rising tone is just Ankh's prod to the party.
Shiomaneking's cry follows story_070's 'Abiiih!! Abi-abi!!', extended for the third 'Abii'. Same at #0.24.

Unlabelled: 0425.bla plays it after CharaNameOut in the branch without Rider 1 (Pt_Chara_Check(1) false), so no name box. Speaker unknown (probably the leader); worded neutrally. #0.24-0.27 are Shiomaneking's lines for that branch.
Rider 1: subject 'we' restored for 'taoshita zo'; 'him' for Shiomaneking (male per glossary).

#0.34-0.44 are 11 leader variants (script +33+k). Mapped by voice and by the 0425.bla chain minus Rider 1 (who has #0.33) and Mebius: Den-O (Momotaros, rough 'da naa', #0.34), RX (#0.35), W (#0.36, 'maa, touzen' as W says again at #0.56), then OOO, Zero, Seven, Ultraman, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00 in story_074. Mebius's slot is uncertain: the chain lists 13 ids but only 11 rows exist.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader-variant orders from 0422/0424/0425.bla Pt_Chara_Check chains, confirmed by voice; 0425 #0.34-0.44 has 11 rows for 12 non-Rider-1 ids (Mebius slot assumed absent). Uncertain: 0425 #0.23 speaker unlabelled (branch without Rider 1). Not in glossary: 'Space Swordsman' (Zamsha's epithet), 'Aquatic Kaijin Team', 'City Outskirts', 'Floor 2' (follows 071/072 'Floor 1').
